review.title: Avoid HDFC SmartHub Vyapar at All Costs!
review.body:
I've been using HDFC SmartHub Vyapar for my business transactions, and it's been a nightmare from day one.

The platform is clunky, slow, and prone to errors. I've had to restart transactions multiple times due to technical glitches.

But what's even more frustrating is the lack of customer support. I've called their helpline multiple times, only to be put on hold for hours
To top it all off, their security measures are laughable. when I reported it to them, they took weeks to investigate and resolve the issue.

Overall, HDFC SmartHub Vyapar is a disaster. I would not recommend it to anyone. They need to seriously overhaul their platform, customer support, and security measures before they can even think about competing with other payment gateways.

- Clunky and error-prone platform
- Poor customer support
- Exorbitant fees and hidden charges
- Laughable security measures

*Recommendation:* Avoid HDFC SmartHub Vyapar at all costs. Look for alternative payment gateways that actually care about their customers."
